title: tauschia ehrenbergii
intro: Tauschia ehrenbergii, commonly known as Mexican Pennyroyal or Yerba Buena, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. It is a member of the carrot family and is valued for its medicinal and aromatic properties. The plant has been traditionally used to aid digestion, relieve headaches, and soothe menstrual cramps, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. Its bioactive constituents, including essential oils and flavonoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
